verification.method: Python standard-library validator covering all schema keywords used here plus refs, formats, cross-object mapping/identity and SSE framing; no dependency installation.
verification.scope: Candidate contract syntax and synthetic examples only; not a full OpenAPI certification or PHIS integration baseline. WeightProfile fact provenance and handshake/WS authentication/renewal control frames remain pending in the main design. No production implementation, database, model, billing-stop or PHIS save verification.
assertions: 6 scene/capability combinations
single target with multiple sourceSections
selected target subset keeps omitted fields unchanged
success,failed,failed/RECORD_VERSION_CONFLICT alternatives
pending/timeout local state only
all local $ref and example schemaRef resolve
positive examples validate; declared invalid examples rejected
SSE sequence, terminal state, full completed result, wire JSON round-trip
failed是保存尝试终态；同failedID重放失败，不能失败变成功
failed后医生重新确认相同正文也使用新writebackRequestId
只有未获终态awaiting网络重传复用同ID
三章最大合并值48307字符，小于WritebackItem.value上限64000
originRequestId在首次assist等于requestId，后续新生成保持origin
每连接新streamId，sequence按stream从1计；同generation断线重放新stream的1/2
本地取消不取消服务端执行/计费，丢弃迟到帧；无远端取消接口
verification.note: 合成契约示例；不能作为真实模型、原生窗口、数据库或PHIS联调证明。握手token为无效合成字符串。
